0022600190.text: The Hawks (6-4, 1st in the Southeast, 4th in the East, on a three-game winning streak) host the Nets (2-6, 5th in the Atlantic, 13th in the East) in Atlanta's 11th game of the season. Atlanta is without Asa Newell (toe), Henri Veesaar (knee), Jock Landale (hip), Keshon Gilbert (knee inflammation) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), while Brooklyn is missing Egor Demin (leg bruise). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Hawks won the 2025-26 season series 4-0, including a 141-107 win in Brooklyn on April 3, 2026.
